## Software Developer
Pune, Maharashtra | Notice: Immediate Joiner

## SUMMARY
Software Developer with 2+ years of professional experience building web applications using React, JavaScript, Java, and REST APIs. Experienced in developing reusable frontend components, integrating backend services, and working with relational databases. Strong foundation in software engineering, debugging, and production deployments.

**Languages:** JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, Java, C#, SQL
**Frontend:** React, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS
**Backend:** Node.js, Spring Boot, REST APIs
**Databases:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server
**Tools:** Git, GitHub, Docker, Postman
